title: D.O. tone rewrite
promptText:
Rewrite the text below as a formal Demi-Official (D.O.) letter from a senior MahaTransco / district administration officer to a peer officer.

Preserve the factual intent. Improve tone, structure, and clarity.

D.O. conventions to follow:
- Opening: respectful personal address (Dear Shri/Smt. …)
- Purpose in the first paragraph
- Context and urgency in the second
- Specific request / coordination needed in the third
- Closing: courtesy line + signature block placeholders
- Avoid bureaucratic padding and legal preamble
- Do not invent designations, dates, or file numbers — use [PLACEHOLDER] where needed
- Length: 120–180 words

Mark any claim that needs confirmation as [VERIFY].

SOURCE TEXT:
[Paste informal memo or email]
